reviews.text: I always get answers to everything, and my dog ​​is in the best place here. I can only recommend it 🙂 …
The Doctor really loves animals...we received all the help and information we could get.

I have never experienced such calmness and kindness anywhere in my life. The doctor and assistant are always very kind and attentive. I came on time and didn't have to wait a minute. I can only recommend this place. Thank you very much for this attitude! I wish you perseverance in your work.
They are always very kind and thorough. Their professional knowledge is outstanding. We couldn't have asked for a better doctor.
Dr. Tímea Laczkó is extremely patient, kind and helpful.

On Saturday, they welcomed us in order of arrival. We received a very thorough abdominal ultrasound examination and detailed findings. It is clear that they work from the heart. We strongly recommend them to all owners! Thank you, Dr. Tímea Laczkó!
Very nice doctor, thorough examination, detailed explanation, patience and love for animals. There is nothing more to say. 5 stars (if possible, more). I can only recommend her to everyone.

I've been looking for exactly this kind of veterinarian for years. Now I've finally found it! He's thorough, listens, asks questions, answers everything, gets to know me, treats me like a competent person, takes me seriously. The pricing is fair, the attitude is excellent. I'm very, very satisfied. I'd happily recommend him to anyone! We've come to the end of a years-long ordeal here after the first time. Finally, I get stable professional support that means security.
They are extremely kind and polite, even on weekends.
I can only recommend them to everyone. They are very kind and knowledgeable.

I was there a week ago, I had an appointment for a Sunday afternoon with my Sphynx cat, a very clean room, a nice assistant was waiting for us, the doctor was thorough, kind, attentive, patient with both the cat and me, I have taken the animals elsewhere so far, unfortunately I did not know about this veterinary clinic sooner! Thank you very much, my cat no longer has urinary problems after the doctor's treatment!
I know my animals are in the best hands! I recommend them to everyone with a clear heart! They always call me back if they can't answer the phone, and they also respond quickly on messenger! ❤️🐶 …
THANK YOU! You were amazing with our little doggy and treated us with so much love and attention. We will forever grateful with you for today.

It would be nice if they weren't unavailable for weeks, months :((( So there's no chance of getting in, and even if we did get in and needed an urgent examination, which is unfortunately a given in a chronic illness, it's still unavailable. And the service that's so inaccessible, a MEDICAL service, is zero :(((( If there really are so many phones, then how do they work, if they put the phone aside, for weeks, months, then....?

I have been taking my beloved Cavalier to the same veterinary clinic for 5 years. However, yesterday (Saturday) evening they were no longer open, so I quickly went online and found BalanceVet. I needed help S.O.S., I called them, but unfortunately they didn't answer the phone at first 😔. However, they called me back within about 10 minutes — no veterinary clinic has ever called me back, which was also very positive.
They were extremely kind even over the phone. We rushed there, and they were already waiting for us. When we entered, cleanliness greeted us. They were VERY, VERY kind, patient and thorough, even though I brought a hysterical Cavalier Spaniel to them 😃.
Even though it was already before closing time, they explained everything to us thoroughly and clearly. We never felt like they were in a hurry or going home. I recommend them to all owners with a pure heart. It was our first time there, but I don't think it will be our last.
Oh, and special thanks to the first doctor who called me back: she didn't recommend medication at first, but an herbal alternative. Thank you so much!
🤩🤩🤩🤩🐶🐶🐶🐶
I recommend them

I adopted a puppy and we came for the first check-up + vaccination. He is a very shy dog, it took me 2 days to let him pet him… After 30 minutes, the doctor and I became best friends, and the doctor didn't even let the dog touch her with a piece of candy:) They are conscientious, together with their assistant, if anyone knows about animals, it would be them. I am infinitely grateful, I am sure that no matter what happens with the puppy, I will come back here even though there are several veterinary clinics closer to me.
They treat the dogs with love.
The doctor was very kind, patient, and helpful. He examined our puppy thoroughly.
We received super kind and fast service, I can only recommend them to everyone. 😊 …

Fairy doctor and assistant.
Highly recommended!
They are very kind to the dog and the owner. They explain everything clearly. It was a very positive experience.
Kind and good veterinarian and assistant, with perfect opening hours. I highly recommend!

The Doctor is very conscientious and helpful. She finds a solution to every problem. She has been treating my cats and dogs for years.
I wholeheartedly recommend her to anyone looking for kind and reliable care for their pet 🙂. …

Well… I can say that I feel extremely lucky: Spyke is 13 years old. I took him to an elderly doctor for 8 years who had incredible professional knowledge and always made him feel calm when I gave him to her. By now, she has almost completely finished practicing and unfortunately has not left behind a successor who I could turn to with confidence (after several negative experiences).

After thinking and searching, I found Dr. Tímea Laczkó and her assistants. I voted for them on the first visit, but also on the second visit: I have Spyke's doctor! She is authentic, reliable, her professional knowledge is at an extremely high level, she explains every problem in a way that even a layperson can understand. The empathy they show towards my little family member is just a plus.

Thank you in advance and afterwards for all the attention and expertise towards our little favorites, Dr. Tímea and her two assistants, Fanni and Beáta!
It is reassuring and truly gratifying that there are still people who take on this demanding and responsible job as a profession!

Very professional, conscientious, kind Team.
I have a lot to thank the Doctor and her assistant.
Eternal gratitude ❤️🐾🐶 …

We visited the clinic for the first time and left with a very positive experience. They treated our cat very kindly and patiently, even on a Sunday afternoon. They were helpful, thorough and answered all our questions willingly. I can only recommend them!😻 …
Fantastic doctor!
I brought my second dog here, who has been with me for a month. He is still afraid of everything, but the doctor treated him very well. We left with another positive experience. I am very satisfied.
The best place to hide, I can only recommend it!
A helpful team.
Helpful, good doctor, kind assistant

We have been going to the Doctor for almost 5 years now and I have a lot to thank her for!
She treats animals in an incredible way, she does her job with dedication, professionalism and love - even my dog ​​who hates all doctors on the show loved her :)
We couldn't find anyone better than her!!
Thank you for allowing us to find a calm, peaceful environment even in moments full of worry😊

Yesterday we had our first visit with my dog ​​Harvey, who is a drama queen (for a male...). They were very nice to him, even though he whined and growled the whole time. They were patient with me and the dog, the doctor charged a minimal examination fee, and the gentleman also got a treat. We will be back in a few weeks. :)
Thorough care, Dr. Laczkó tells and explains everything. The assistance and conditions also deserve praise. :)

Very nice doctor and assistant lady too! I get accurate answers to my questions! We finally found the perfect environment and the perfect professionals. She doesn't treat our little dachshund like a piece of shit.
I feel calm when we go to the doctor because our little 4-legged child is in the best hands!
They saw us right away on Sunday around 6:30. They were kind, thorough, and we even received our home medications on the spot. The price was very fair!

Dear team!

Thank you very much for your help yesterday ALSO!
After we survived the spay and neuter and couldn't reach the original location, you even called us back and we got the care so that Nova wouldn't vomit all night after the anesthesia, we are much better and very grateful! I recommend the place to everyone with love!

We've been with my dog ​​for about a week. We had several problems, but they treated us very patiently even on Sunday evening. I've been to many doctors with BPn, especially in the 14th district, and none of them can match this clinic :)) The price is also fair and the expertise is evident. I recommend them to everyone.
I simply love them!
They are very attentive and kind, I have only had positive experiences so far

We have been going to TDN for many, many years, and we always receive a very high level of professional, yet kind and owner-friendly service. My dogs also love the assistant lady. I would definitely recommend her to everyone.
Everyone is very kind, helpful, and prepared! I can only recommend it!
